prompt:
Production game inventory icon atlas, perfectly SQUARE canvas, invisible exact 4 by 4 grid of equal square cells, exactly sixteen separate inventory items. Fully transparent background. Original hand-painted Chinese wuxia inventory art, miniature gouache and watercolor texture, delicate warm-brown outlines, soft top-left light. Shaolin monastery collection: ochre, dark brown, aged brass. No people or hands. No text, no letters, no numerals, no labels, no grids, no frames, no glow, no background scenery. Abstract cover motifs only. Every object centered inside its own cell with at least 15 percent fully transparent margin on all four sides. No object may cross a cell boundary. Match relative visual weight. Tall objects must fit within their cell, diagonal when appropriate. Sixteen items in exact row-major order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Thin ochre stitched boxing booklet, thick brown binding cord, square embossed fist symbol, dark cloth corner guards.
2. Horizontal martial scroll on thick wooden rollers, yellow hemp backing, three parallel staff path marks.
3. Brown accordion folio with circular bell rubbing, layered palm-shaped paper diagram, aged brass clasp.
4. Long double-ended folding staff manual with wooden end covers and one ochre cloth band across its center.
5. Palm-sized beige softcover breathing booklet, layered earth-ring seal on cover, thin dangling spine cord.
6. Thick brown leather-clasp manual with ochre pages, a flat stone paperweight and a worn hemp loop.
7. Dark ochre cloth book case holding a narrow sutra, tiny flat bronze bell clasp, restrained monastery craft.
8. Three-panel grey-brown stair rubbing with ochre footprints and plain kraft paper corner sleeve.
9. Slim cylindrical wooden scroll case, carved turning-arrow band, short yellow cord, narrow rolled paper visible.
10. Loose annotated practice sheets between bamboo boards, ochre correction dots, flat wooden tag at edge.
11. Dark hardwood staff diagonally placed, aged brass end caps, three pale grip-spacing rings at center.
12. Pair of thick black iron wrist rings, brown cloth lining, fine brass bands set into their outer edges.
13. Folded ochre short-hem monk robe, dark brown shoulder patches, broad cloth sash tied in a square knot.
14. Square dark wooden duty token, shallow monastery-gate relief, three short notches, thick yellow hanging cord.
15. Squat ochre ceramic salve jar, cream cloth seal, small wooden spatula resting beside it, brown tied string.
16. Small flat dark wooden case slightly open, worn circular bell rubbing and a notched bronze fragment inside.
Do not add, omit, merge or duplicate items. An item's paired pieces should remain grouped inside its single cell. High small-size silhouette readability.
revision_prompt:
Edit the supplied 4x4 Shaolin inventory icon atlas. Goal: every martial arts manual must visually communicate its specific martial TYPE. Keep exactly sixteen items in the same row-major positions, transparent background, warm ochre brown aged-brass watercolor style. Preserve unchanged icons 1,2,3,8,12,13,14,15,16 exactly in identity. Replace ONLY these seven items:
CELL 4 row1 col4: replace long wooden case with a RECTANGULAR ochre stitched PALM TECHNIQUE MANUAL, cover bearing a very clear upright open-palm hand outline with a small concentric force circle; no unrelated box.
CELL 5 row2 col1: rectangular beige inner-energy manual whose cover shows an unmistakable simple seated meditation outline with concentric BREATHING circles around the lower belly, minimal anatomical pictogram, no lettering.
CELL 6 row2 col2: open rectangular brown bound INNER ENERGY MANUAL showing a simplified back/torso meridian diagram, spine and limbs marked with fine connected dots. Remove stone paperweight so the meridian diagram is unobstructed.
CELL 7 row2 col3: ochre rectangular open scripture with a clear spinal-meridian line and seated meditation pictogram, as an inner-energy scripture. Remove bell clasp and wooden case.
CELL 9 row3 col1: replace cylindrical closed case with an unfolded RECTANGULAR cream and brown footwork diagram: a sequence of bold FOOTPRINTS connected by curved movement arrows; small seated meditation symbol in one corner, for Nine Diagrams Six Seated Images footwork. No fan shape or loose unrelated object.
CELL 10 row3 col2: practice sheets held by flat bamboo boards, very clear repeated FIST diagrams and small movement arrows. No swords or rods. Shaolin boxing practice notes.
CELL 11 row3 col3: full-length slim traditional Shaolin wooden staff, no blade and no ritual head, aged brass endcaps, wrapped center grip. Keep diagonal within cell but make its length-to-thickness ratio at least 12:1 so it reads as a long staff rather than a short baton.
All remaining objects keep their present correct identity and appearance. Existing cell2's scroll with three staffs, cell3's prominent palm diagram and cell8's stairs/footprints already communicate correct martial types and must remain. Each entire icon centered at grid coordinate 12.5/37.5/62.5/87.5 percent, with at least 13% empty margin inside its equal square cell. NO cross-cell overlap, no object or loose fibers crossing cell boundaries. Small symbols may be diagram drawings but NO readable text, characters, numbers or pseudo-calligraphy. No human characters or separate people (tiny printed diagram silhouettes on the books are allowed). No fans, labels, gridlines, borders, scenery. Square RGBA transparent atlas.
visual_review: Thumbnail semantic audit: 16 icons retain row-major order. SL004 palm manual, SL005 breathing diagram, SL006 meridians, SL007 seated meridians, SL009 footprints, SL010 boxing notes, SL011 slender long staff are revised; other identities are retained. Generated output visually checked; transparent RGBA verified with zero alpha>32 pixels at all equal-grid boundaries and outer edges. Per-item observations are recorded in thumbnail audit report.
